description: This file defines several custom exception classes used within the errors handling in the project, including MsgException, WaitForResponseTimedOutError, DeviceUnresponsiveError, InstrumentationError, AbortError, and ParseError.

classes.name: MsgException
classes.description: A generic exception class with an optional message string.

classes.name: WaitForResponseTimedOutError
classes.description: Exception indicating a response timeout when waiting for device.

classes.name: DeviceUnresponsiveError
classes.description: Exception indicating that a device is unresponsive.

classes.name: InstrumentationError
classes.description: Exception for failures in running instrumentation.

classes.name: AbortError
classes.description: A fatal exception indicating the program should abort, inheriting from MsgException.

classes.name: ParseError
classes.description: Exception raised when XML data has an unrecognized format, inheriting from MsgException.

methods.name: __init__(self, msg="")
methods.description: Initializer for MsgException, sets an optional message.
